programme_facts.value: Must have been living in an EU/EEA member state or Switzerland for at least 3 of the 5 years before starting the course.
Must be a citizen of an EU/EEA member state or Switzerland or have official refugee status.
Must be a first-time full-time undergraduate.
Must be undertaking a full-time undergraduate course of at least 2 years' duration.
Cannot be undertaking a repeat year of study at the same level unless evidence of exceptional circumstances is provided.
Eligible for the Higher Education Authority’s Free Fees scheme if all criteria are satisfied.
Liable to EU fees if citizenship and residency criteria are satisfied but fail to meet course requirements.
Liable to Non EU fees if neither citizenship nor residency criteria are met.
